result: {"status":"abandon","summary":"I made no code change. I profiled q19.m0 on the current best before touching anything. The lineitem TABLE_SCAN lists only one optional filter on the shipmode column: `optional: l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG')`. A ConjunctionAnd prints its children joined with \" AND \", and this line has none, so the filter is a single top-level OPTIONAL_FILTER. RowGroup::CheckZonemap (row_group.cpp:626) already marks that kind of filter always-true and skips it. The AND-of-optionals the issue describes (IN plus OR-of-equals on the same column) is not produced for q19 on the current engine. The issue's A/B microbench only created it by adding an extra OR predicate to the query. Since the cost isn't in the q19 profile, the change would have no effect there.","generality":"If the fix were landed, it would help only scans where two or more plain optional pushdowns land on the same column. That case does not occur in the visible q19 instances on the current best.","notes":"The only AND of optionals in the q19 lineitem scan is in the dynamic filters on l_partkey (`optional >= AND optional <= AND optional BF`). Those are SelectivityOptionalFilter (min/max and Bloom filter) and really do filter, so the planned skip rightly leaves them alone. The scan takes 5.84s of operator time (cumulative over threads); total query time is 0.786s. Better places to look for q19 scan time are the BF/min-max dynamic filter cost on l_partkey, the expression-filter evaluation of the l_quantity OR-of-ranges, and the shipinstruct equality on a Dictionary/FSST column. The upper FILTER on the shipmode OR takes 0.12s. Before planning around an AND-of-optionals, check the current profile."}

structured_output.summary: I made no code change. I profiled q19.m0 on the current best before touching anything. The lineitem TABLE_SCAN lists only one optional filter on the shipmode column: `optional: l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'AIR REG')`. A ConjunctionAnd prints its children joined with " AND ", and this line has none, so the filter is a single top-level OPTIONAL_FILTER. RowGroup::CheckZonemap (row_group.cpp:626) already marks that kind of filter always-true and skips it. The AND-of-optionals the issue describes (IN plus OR-of-equals on the same column) is not produced for q19 on the current engine. The issue's A/B microbench only created it by adding an extra OR predicate to the query. Since the cost isn't in the q19 profile, the change would have no effect there.
structured_output.generality: If the fix were landed, it would help only scans where two or more plain optional pushdowns land on the same column. That case does not occur in the visible q19 instances on the current best.
structured_output.notes: The only AND of optionals in the q19 lineitem scan is in the dynamic filters on l_partkey (`optional >= AND optional <= AND optional BF`). Those are SelectivityOptionalFilter (min/max and Bloom filter) and really do filter, so the planned skip rightly leaves them alone. The scan takes 5.84s of operator time (cumulative over threads); total query time is 0.786s. Better places to look for q19 scan time are the BF/min-max dynamic filter cost on l_partkey, the expression-filter evaluation of the l_quantity OR-of-ranges, and the shipinstruct equality on a Dictionary/FSST column. The upper FILTER on the shipmode OR takes 0.12s. Before planning around an AND-of-optionals, check the current profile.
